title: MCX Expiry Dates for November and December 2026
summary: Check MCX futures and options expiry dates for crude oil, natural gas, gold, silver and copper. See November and December 2026 dates and broker cutoffs.
body_markdown:
MCX expiry dates are the last trading days of commodity futures and options contracts on the Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX), and they vary by commodity and contract type. In November 2026, Crude Oil options expire on 17 November and futures on 19 November. Natural Gas options expire on 20 November and futures on 24 November. The calendar below lists each option’s expiry next to its underlying futures expiry.

If an expiry date falls on a weekend or a full trading holiday, the contract usually expires on the previous trading day. A partial holiday can still be an expiry day. On 24 November 2026, MCX’s morning session is closed for Guru Nanak Jayanti, but the evening session is open, so Natural Gas futures still expire that day. Our[MCX holidays](https://algotest.in/blog/mcx-holidays/) list shows which days are full or partial closures.


### What Happens to Your Position at Expiry


-


**Cash-settled futures:** Crude oil and natural gas futures are settled in cash at a price linked to their US NYMEX benchmarks, converted to rupees. No barrels or gas change hands.


-


**Physically delivered futures:** Gold, silver and copper futures can end in delivery if you hold them into the tender period, and margins rise as expiry gets closer.


-


**Options:** An in-the-money option held to expiry normally turns into a futures position, unless the long holder submits a valid contrary instruction. Out-of-the-money options expire worthless.


-


**Extra margin near expiry:** Brokers can ask for futures margin before an option expires. On option expiry day, for example, Zerodha blocks 100% of the futures margin for NRML in-the-money long options.


Our[MCX options trading](https://algotest.in/blog/mcx-options-trading/) guide explains how this conversion, called devolvement, works.

### Tender Period and Broker Cutoffs


The tender period is the window before expiry when delivery can be assigned on a physically delivered contract.


-


**Gold and silver:** For the gold and silver futures covered here, the staggered delivery period covers the final three trading days, including expiry day. MCX cut it from five days to three, phasing the change in by symbol through 2025 and 2026.


-


**Copper:** The tender period also covers the last three trading days, including expiry day.


-


**Crude oil and natural gas:** These are cash-settled, so there is no tender period.


For example, the December 2026 Gold Mini contract expires on 4 December, so its tender period runs from 2 to 4 December.


Brokers usually ask you to close delivery positions before the tender period starts. For the 4 September 2026 Gold Mini and Silver expiry, FYERS set a cutoff of 9:00 PM on 1 September. For the 5 November 2026 Gold Mini expiry, Zerodha set 10:30 PM on 2 November. Check your broker’s notice for each contract.


*Source: MCX circular MCX/TRD/383/2025, Modification in Staggered Delivery Period in Commodity Futures Contracts.*


## What Time Do MCX Contracts Expire in India?


Traders often mean one of three different times:


-


**Session close:** The current non-agricultural MCX session runs from 9:00 AM to 11:55 PM IST until 12 March 2027. See[MCX trading time](https://algotest.in/blog/mcx-trading-time/) for the full schedule.


-


**Exchange expiry-day cutoff:** Some physically delivered contracts stop trading early on expiry day. MCX’s notice for the April 2027 Gold Ten contract, for example, allows expiry-day trading only until 5:00 PM IST.


-


**Broker margin deadline:** Brokers set their own deadlines. Zerodha, for example, asks for futures margin on in-the-money options by 7:00 PM on option expiry day.

### FAQs


#### What is the MCX expiry date for crude oil this month?


In November 2026, Crude Oil and Crude Oil Mini options expire on 17 November and futures on 19 November. In December, options expire on 16 December and futures on 18 December.


#### When does MCX gold expire?


Gold and Gold Mini options expire on 27 November 2026, and their underlying futures expire on 4 December 2026. Gold (1 kg) futures expire on the 5th of February, April, June, August, October and December, and Gold Mini futures on the 5th of every month.


#### Do MCX Silver and Silver Mini options expire on the same day?


Their dates can differ. In November 2026, Silver Mini options expire on 23 November and standard Silver options on 27 November. Their underlying futures expire on 30 November and 4 December, respectively.


#### Why do MCX Natural Gas futures expire on 24 November 2026 if it is a holiday?


MCX closes its morning session for Guru Nanak Jayanti and opens for the evening session. The published November Natural Gas futures expiry is 24 November, and Natural Gas options expire on 20 November.


#### What time do MCX contracts expire?


It depends on the contract and your broker. The normal session runs until 11:55 PM IST in winter, some delivery contracts such as Gold Ten stop at 5:00 PM IST on expiry day, and brokers set their own earlier cutoffs.


#### Do MCX options expire before futures?


Yes. Crude oil and natural gas options expire two business days before their futures, and bullion and copper options expire before their futures enter the tender period.
